provenance.method: exact Z[i] codimension-2 Galois quotient over Q(i, sqrt(3)) on all 1,080 3-qubit stabilizer states

llm.role: we* multi-agent algebraic quotient and exact certificate synthesis

notes: Pairs with the Lean rank-3 upper bound to settle chi(|T>^3) = 3 with zero floating-point margins in either direction. Upgraded from reproduced to verified (exact: true) via the division-free Z[i] codimension-2 Galois quotient modulo P_3 = span_{Q(i)}(A_3, B_3), where (3 + sqrt(3))^3 |T>^3 = A_3 + sqrt(3) B_3 in Z[i]^8 + sqrt(3) Z[i]^8. Across all 1,080 3-qubit stabilizer states, 0 states lie in P_3 and none of the parallel ray groups in Q(i)^8 / P_3 spans P_3. Positive controls at m=2 (3 exact rank-2 decompositions) and m=3 rank 3 (72 exact decompositions) are verified in the same run.
